Test fonts
==========

mplus1p-supplementary-subset.ttf and mplus1p-bmp-subset.ttf are subsets of
M+ 1p Regular (mplus1p-regular-webfont.ttf), Copyright 2016 The M+ Project
Authors, licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org). The licence text is also in the name table of
each file.

- mplus1p-supplementary-subset.ttf: ASCII, U+7530, U+1D538, U+20B9F, U+20BB7
- mplus1p-bmp-subset.ttf: ASCII, U+7530

Symbolic font encodings
=======================

Used by tests/symbolic_font_tounicode.php as the expected ToUnicode mappings of
the Symbol and ZapfDingbats standard fonts. Each file keeps its own notice.

- adobe-symbol.txt and adobe-zdingbat.txt: "Adobe Symbol Encoding to Unicode"
  and "Adobe Zapf Dingbats Encoding to Unicode", Copyright (c) 1991-2011
  Unicode, Inc., from https://unicode.org/Public/MAPPINGS/VENDORS/ADOBE/
- agl-zapfdingbats.txt: the ITC Zapf Dingbats Glyph List, Copyright 2002-2019
  Adobe, BSD 3-Clause, from https://github.com/adobe-type-tools/agl-aglfn
